text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After running great in the Aoi Stakes, 
Curren Chan's cuteness is a hit across 
social media. She's on a total roll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, you bump into Eishin 
Flash, who debuted during the same period.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With tomorrow's Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby) ahead, she worked tirelessly down 
to the wire on her final adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Swept up by her sheer intensity, Curren 
Chan decided she wanted to watch the 
Japanese Derby in person.
